verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents a broad programmatic surface. Cloud APIs are usable via REST or client libraries to automate workflows, and the gcloud CLI manages resources and interacts with those APIs. Billing has its own REST API, and infrastructure can be defined declaratively with Terraform through Infrastructure Manager. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that the APIs match everything the console can do, and independent or hands-on confirmation that UI-only gaps don't exist.
